name: JOOLA Essentials Court Polo
description: The JOOLA Essentials Court Polo is a collared performance shirt for players who need club or league dress-code compliance without giving up comfort. The recycled polyester knit wicks sweat and dries quickly, UPF 40 sun protection shields the shoulders during outdoor play, and a stretch side panel allows a full overhead swing without the hem riding up.
care_instructions: Machine wash cold with like colors and tumble dry low. Do not use fabric softener, which clogs the moisture-wicking fibers. Do not iron the logo.
